question: Should AlphaLedger remain an equity-only agent or extend to the authenticated live track before kickoff?
assumptions: The authenticated live dashboard is the strongest current event-state source.
Options Alpha Agents is the only displayed track, but its detailed brief may not be released until kickoff.
The public challenge still permits Alpaca trading agents broadly.
Options introduce tail, liquidity, expiration, assignment, and multi-leg execution risks that must be visible rather than hidden behind a predictor.
options: build a generic directional options predictor
extend the verified baseline with a defined-risk options agent and optional structured AI critic

facts: options are enabled by default in Alpaca paper accounts
option orders use the Orders API
option quantity must be whole and notional must be omitted
mleg payloads contain explicit legs and position intents
no options or actual model integration existed

decision: Extend rather than replace the baseline: lead with one-contract, capped-loss bull call debit-spread planning; make stale data, missing Greeks, liquidity, expiration, account state, and maximum loss hard gates; keep an optional OpenAI structured advisory lane veto-only and default-off.
claim_ceiling: C1 mechanics on a frozen synthetic option chain
falsifiers: The kickoff track brief excludes or materially changes the options requirement.
The installed Alpaca schema rejects the generated multi-leg shape.
Any model output can override a deterministic gate.
Any naked or unlimited-loss options shape reaches an order plan.
Any stale, illiquid, missing-Greeks, excessive-loss, live-mode, underfunded, or unreconciled-order scenario passes.
Any proposal can understate quote-derived economics without forcing abstention.
negative_controls: optimistic advisory against a policy-invalid spread
stop_rule: Stop feature expansion after the valid options plan, named falsifiers, shared ledger, dashboard path, and submission narrative verify; wait for the kickoff brief and paper-account read-only reconciliation before broker work.

verification.browser_valid_path: CALL DEBIT / $20 maximum loss / PASS / SIMULATED
browser_falsifiers: stale option evidence produces ABSTAIN with no payload
unavailable optional AI advisory produces ABSTAIN
